Bundled browser libraries (no CDN or build step required):

- Prism 1.29.0: https://github.com/PrismJS/prism
- Acorn 8.14.1: https://github.com/acornjs/acorn
- CSS Tree 3.1.0: https://github.com/csstree/csstree
- HTMLHint 1.1.4: https://github.com/htmlhint/HTMLHint

Files come from the corresponding pinned npm package tarballs. Licenses are included alongside the bundles.
